structure: Part 26, Declaration and confirmation. Read both spec files in full (confirmation.fit.spec.js: 'confirmation feature' 1 test, 'submitted confirmation feature' 4 tests; declaration.fit.spec.js: 'declaration feature' 4 tests, 'declaration submission' 1 test) and mined all 10 trace zips: confirmation 40737 (unsubmitted redirect), bc3a5 (render), 88be8 (dashboard link), 86dee (create new), 00349 (axe); declaration dbd39 (render), c39b7 (validation), 5267c (back link), 9c034 (axe), 49d7b (submission). The tim trace CLI could not open these zips ('The trace was created by a newer version of Playwright and is not supported by this version of the viewer'), so each zip, already unpacked in the part26 working folder (c1-c5, d1-d5, mapping confirmed from each trace's title), was read directly: the action list from test.trace and 1-trace.trace, rendered DOM from the frame-snapshot taken on arrival at each page, and the network log from 1-trace.network. Pages, in journey order: (1) Declaration, /live-animals/notifications/{ref}/declaration, reached by Continue from the check-answers page (notification-view) or directly by URL; one checkbox, a date line, Continue; error state on submitting unticked; renders identically for an incomplete notification (only origin answered) and a complete one. (2) Import notification submitted (confirmation), /live-animals/notifications/{ref}/confirmation, reached only after a successful declaration POST; panel with reference, four sections (Before the consignment is imported, Transporting the consignment, How to view or amend this notification, Getting help), no back link, no Draft strip. Conditional: confirmation redirects to the notification hub when the notification is not submitted; declaration redirects to confirmation once submitted. Also seen in passing: the dashboard card for the submitted notification (status Submitted) after Return to your dashboard, and the origin page of a fresh notification after Create a new notification. Every component on both pages is govuk-* except app-journey-strip (declaration) and app-link-button (confirmation).

claims.statement: The declaration page is at /live-animals/notifications/{reference}/declaration and is reached by pressing Continue on the check-answers page (notification-view), which POSTs and redirects there.

claims.statement: The declaration page can be opened directly by URL for a draft notification that has only its origin answered, and it renders in full (same content as for a complete notification); no completeness guard stops the trader reaching it.
claims.ref: trace dbd39 (declaration.fit.spec.js:36) action call@1857 goto declaration -> 200; snapshot identical to trace bc3a5 call@1551
claims.quote: GET http://localhost:3000/live-animals/notifications/GBN-AG-26-VTJZ1J/declaration 200

claims.quote: I am the contact for the authorities and located in the UK.

claims.quote: I am complying with the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2017/625 including on animal health and welfare.

claims.statement: The second declaration statement is an h2 'I confirm I am responsible for this consignment.'
claims.quote: I confirm I am responsible for this consignment.

claims.statement: Under the responsibility statement, a paragraph sets the period of responsibility.
claims.quote: I am responsible from the submission of this notification to when it enters Great Britain. And I am responsible until it has either:

claims.statement: The responsibility period ends at one of two bulleted events: 'cleared official checks at the border' or 'reached the Place of Destination as stated on the health certificate or notification'.
claims.quote: cleared official checks at the border | reached the Place of Destination as stated on the health certificate or notification

claims.statement: The third declaration statement is an h2 'I confirm that I am accountable for:'
claims.quote: I confirm that I am accountable for:

claims.statement: The accountability statement is followed by four bullets covering payment for official controls, re-dispatch, quarantine or isolation costs, and destruction and disposal costs.
claims.ref: trace dbd39 actions call@1875, call@1877, call@1879, call@1881
claims.quote: any payment for the official controls at the border | any arrangements to re-dispatch the consignment | any costs needed for quarantine or isolation of consignments | any costs needed for destruction and disposal of consignments, when instructed by the authorities

claims.statement: A paragraph states the trader is authorised to be accountable when raising notifications for a third party.
claims.quote: I am authorised as being accountable for these things if raising notifications on behalf of a third party.

claims.statement: A final paragraph states the trader can legally act for a third party under the declaration's conditions.
claims.quote: I can legally act on behalf of a third party in relation to the conditions of this declaration.

claims.statement: The declaration form has a single GOV.UK checkbox (name 'declaration', value 'confirmed', id 'declaration'), unticked on arrival, with no hint and no fieldset legend.
claims.ref: trace dbd39 action call@1857 snapshot form .govuk-checkboxes

claims.statement: The declaration checkbox label reads 'I confirm that I have reviewed and comply with this declaration and that the information submitted in this notification is true and correct.'
claims.quote: I confirm that I have reviewed and comply with this declaration and that the information submitted in this notification is true and correct.

claims.statement: Below the checkbox the page shows 'Date of declaration:' followed by today's date in long form (day, full month name, year); it is display text, not an input.
claims.ref: trace dbd39 action call@1889 (text /^Date of declaration:/); snapshot call@1857
claims.quote: Date of declaration: 7 October 2026
claims.note: Traces recorded on 7 October 2026, so the date shown is the current date; the spec title says 'the current date'.

claims.statement: The declaration form's submit button is a primary GOV.UK button labelled 'Continue'.
claims.quote: Continue

claims.statement: The declaration form posts back to its own URL with hidden fields crumb (CSRF token) and concurrencyToken, plus declaration=confirmed when ticked.
claims.quote: crumb=[REDACTED]&concurrencyToken=0&declaration=confirmed

claims.statement: Submitting the declaration without ticking the checkbox re-renders the page with HTTP 400 and does not submit the notification.
claims.quote: POST http://localhost:3000/live-animals/notifications/GBN-AG-26-VTJZ1J/declaration 400

claims.statement: The same message shows as an inline error above the checkbox (id declaration-error, prefixed by visually hidden 'Error:'), and the form group takes the error style.
claims.quote: Error: Confirm that you have reviewed and comply with this declaration

claims.statement: In the error state the browser title is prefixed 'Error: '.

claims.quote: Date of declaration: 7 October 2026

claims.statement: Ticking the declaration and pressing Continue on a complete notification submits it and redirects (302) to /live-animals/notifications/{reference}/confirmation.

claims.statement: Once a notification is submitted, going back to its declaration URL redirects (302) to its confirmation page, so the declaration cannot be made again.
claims.ref: trace 49d7b actions call@2759, call@2761; network GET /declaration 302
claims.quote: GET http://localhost:3000/live-animals/notifications/GBN-AG-26-VEQEJZ/declaration 302 http://localhost:3000/live-animals/notifications/GBN-AG-26-VEQEJZ/confirmation

No trace shows the confirmation or declaration pages for an amended (resubmitted) notification, though the confirmation copy says notifications can be amended and resubmitted.
